messages:
maria: Heads-up — Skyline (enterprise fintech) needs a compliance package for the POC. They asked for: redacted SOC 2 excerpts (control mappings), a signed pen-test attestation letter, network / data-flow diagram for the on-prem connector, staging IP allowlist, and KMS separation notes. Also flagged: need model-version EOL & whether Dedicated pricing changes latency SLA. Can someone own the artifact handoff and signatory?

sam: I can collect the artifacts and assemble a package. Quick Q: do they want the full control narrative or just the sections that touch data-in-transit/storage?

maria: They said "control mappings + evidence snippets" — minimal redactions ok. Timeline: they'd like this before EOW (Fri). Also they want a signed pen-test letter they can hand to their security team.

alisha: We can provide: redacted SOC2 section (in-scope systems + control mappings), a pen-test attestation (not the full report) signed by Security. We do NOT share raw vuln scan output. For KMS: we can supply an architecture diagram showing CMK separation & HSM integration, and a short statement about key custody.

ben: For network diagram / allowlist — I can export the staging IP ranges and a simple VPC peering diagram. Staging egress: 34.120.16.0/20, 34.121.32.0/20, plus our NAT ranges. If they need static IPs for a dedicated POC we can bolt on elastic NATs but that affects pricing and provisioning time.

sam: OK — plan: I will draft the bundle (zip) and upload to our compliance S3 dropbox at s3://redwood-compliance/skyline-poc-2777/ then share a presigned link. Alisha — can you review & sign the pen-test attestation? I'll attach this template and flag fields to fill.

alisha: Yes — please include the snippet below and mark <SIGNATORY_NAME> as me. I need the customer legal name and the scope line filled.

alisha: ```
Penetration Test Attestation
Date: <DATE>
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a third-party penetration test was conducted against the production inferencing surface scoped to the customer tenant controls listed below. Redwood did not include customer-provided datasets in the scope of the vendor test. No critical vulnerabilities affecting confidentiality or integrity were identified in the in-scope surface at the time of testing.
Signed,
<SIGNATORY_NAME> (Head of Security)
```

maria: Perfect. Also, Skyline asked whether Dedicated capacity incurs an additional setup lead of 2 weeks and if that changes the POC pricing. From pricing: Dedicated adds a one-time setup fee + monthly commit — please call out delta in the quote.

sam: I'll surface the delta in the quote and mark it as optional for the POC. Action items: (1) sam — assemble zip + upload; (2) ben — export VPC diagram + IP list; (3) alisha — sign attestation once draft is in S3; (4) maria — confirm timeline with customer and send quote addendum.

deploy-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/skyline-poc-2777/package_v1.zip (presigned link expires in 7 days) :thumbsup:

sam: Uploaded package v1. Contents: SOC2-redacted.pdf, pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf, network-diagram.pdf, kms-separation.png, staging-ips.txt, quote-addendum.pdf. @alisha please review pen-test-attestation-draft.pdf and sign.

alisha: Reviewing now. If minor edits I'll sign; if we need to add legal boilerplate we'll loop legal. ETA 2 hours.

maria: Thanks team — I'll tell Skyline we expect to have signed attestation + docs by EOD and will include optional Dedicated pricing delta.

sam: Noted. Will update thread when signed.
